Settings.QueryText: SELECT DocumentFolio.Ref AS Ref, DocumentFolio.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, DocumentFolio.Number AS Number, DocumentFolio.Date AS Date, DocumentFolio.Posted AS Posted, DocumentFolio.Description AS Description, DocumentFolio.Hotel AS Hotel, DocumentFolio.Company AS Company, DocumentFolio.IsClosed AS IsClosed, DocumentFolio.IsClosedAuthor AS IsClosedAuthor, DocumentFolio.IsClosedDate AS IsClosedDate, DocumentFolio.FolioCurrency AS FolioCurrency, DocumentFolio.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, DocumentFolio.Agent AS Agent, DocumentFolio.Customer AS Customer, DocumentFolio.Contract AS Contract, DocumentFolio.Client AS Client, DocumentFolio.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, DocumentFolio.FinancialAccount AS FinancialAccount, DocumentFolio.Room AS Room, DocumentFolio.DateTimeFrom AS DateTimeFrom, DocumentFolio.DateTimeTo AS DateTimeTo, DocumentFolio.PaymentSection AS PaymentSection, DocumentFolio.PaymentMethod AS PaymentMethod, DocumentFolio.CreditLimit AS CreditLimit, DocumentFolio.Remarks AS Remarks, DocumentFolio.IsMaster AS IsMaster, DocumentFolio.DoNotUpdateCompany AS DoNotUpdateCompany, DocumentFolio.DoNotUpdateCustomer AS DoNotUpdateCustomer, DocumentFolio.DoNotFillAgent AS DoNotFillAgent, DocumentFolio.HotelProduct AS HotelProduct, DocumentFolio.DebtDecision AS DebtDecision, DocumentFolio.DebtDecisionAuthor AS DebtDecisionAuthor, DocumentFolio.DebtDecisionDate AS DebtDecisionDate, DocumentFolio.DebtDecisionRemarks AS DebtDecisionRemarks, DocumentFolio.FolioDiscountCard AS FolioDiscountCard, DocumentFolio.FolioDiscountType AS FolioDiscountType, DocumentFolio.LineNumber AS LineNumber, DocumentFolio.IsComplimentary AS IsComplimentary, DocumentFolio.IsHouseUse AS IsHouseUse, DocumentFolio.IsForDirectPostings AS IsForDirectPostings, DocumentFolio.IsForExternalPOS AS IsForExternalPOS, DocumentFolio.Author AS Author, DocumentFolio.PointInTime AS PointInTime, ISNULL(FolioBalances.SumBalance, 0) AS SumBalance, DocumentFolio.IsArchived AS IsArchived FROM Document.Folio AS DocumentFolio LEFT JOIN (SELECT FolioBalances.Folio AS Folio, FolioBalances.SumBalance AS SumBalance FROM AccumulationRegister.Accounts.Balance(, ) AS FolioBalances) AS FolioBalances ON (FolioBalances.Folio = DocumentFolio.Ref) WHERE CASE WHEN &qHotel <> VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef) THEN DocumentFolio.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) AND DocumentFolio.Hotel <> VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef) ELSE TRUE END
